# Spencer Morley Consulting — Discoverability Index

> AI-search discoverability audits for Canadian small businesses. We score how a business shows up across AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini), classic search, and the machine-readable web, then rank it against named local competitors and show what the gap costs.

Spencer Morley Consulting is an Edmonton, Alberta AI advisory practice led by Jordan Morley. The Discoverability Index is its productized service for small and local businesses.

## What the Discoverability Index measures

- Classical SEO — whether search engines can read, index, and rank the site.
- AI visibility (AEO/GEO) — whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini name the business when buyers ask for recommendations.
- webMCP readiness — structured data, llms.txt, and an AI manifest so AI agents can use the business's information.
- Canadian trust signals — Google Business Profile, HomeStars, Consumer Choice (Canada), TrustedPros, and local reviews.

The output is a single 0–100 score (the SDI), a competitor leaderboard, a dollars-at-stake estimate, and a 90-day roadmap.

## Services and pricing (CAD)

- Discoverability Report — $1,500. The full scan and roadmap. Credited in full against the Fix Sprint, so if the client proceeds with the fixes the Report costs them nothing.
- Report + Fix Sprint — $3,900. The audit plus done-for-you fixes (structured data, llms.txt, meta and headings, Google Business Profile).
- Discoverability Monitoring — $400/month, 3-month minimum. Quarterly re-score, monthly AI-visibility pulse, competitor-overtake alerts, light ongoing fixes.
- Sector leaderboard — for trade associations and franchises; pricing on request.

## Who it is for

Local and small businesses whose customers research before they buy: trades, home services (plumbing, HVAC, flooring, roofing), dental and health clinics, professional services, and specialty retail, primarily in Edmonton and Alberta.

## Published research

- The Canadian AI Search Visibility Benchmark (2026) — SMC's own dataset of 75 businesses across 8 sectors, all scored on this rubric: https://spencermorleyconsulting.ca/blog/canadian-ai-search-visibility-benchmark-2026.html
  Median Discoverability Index 48/100 (44 for Canadian independent local businesses). In 4 of 8 scored sectors the classical-SEO leader is a different business from the AI-answer leader. 63 of 75 (84%) score below half on machine-readable readiness; 0 of 25 probed sites serve a valid AI manifest at a standard path. Businesses anonymized; limits published.
